text:
incident-bot: ALERT: kv-paged block-manager metadata growth detected on us-east-1-serving. blockstore usage > 85% on 6 nodes. suspected continuous-batching regression. creating thread for live mitigation.

anya: yep seeing it in dashboards — KV paged block metadata count spike starting ~08:12 UTC, correlates with a deploy around 08:10. p95 token latency up ~3x for some customers, and a few 429s.

michael: logs show repeated blockmanager 'regen' cycles and long GC pauses: `block_manager: regen_metadata loop took 4.2s` several times. also heavy disk IO.

jamal: impact? any customer-facing failures?

anya: most traffic OK but two high-traffic tenants (acme-inc, quickchat) see request timeouts and 503s for generation endpoints. error burst started 08:13.

karen: oncall checklist: disable continuous batching fallback, reduce max_batch_tokens, trigger manual eviction for cold prefixes. I'm going to propose steps.

anya: agree. quick mitigation path: 1) flip continuous_batching OFF on host pool; 2) lower max_batch_tokens to 64 and max_wait_ms to 10; 3) run target eviction to free blockmanager to ~60%; 4) patch block_size to reduce per-block memory then monitor.

jamal: how to flip continuous batching quickly? admin endpoint?

anya: admin API: `POST https://internal-admin.us-east-1/api/v1/config` body: `{"feature_flags": {"continuous_batching": false}}` — I can run that on the region config and it will cascade to serving proxies.

michael: I can run it. will do now and watch for regressions.

deploy-bot: STARTED rollout: region-config/continuous-batching-toggle by michael @ 1769999052 (canary 2 nodes).

michael: done for canary. metrics show immediate drop in batch size distribution (median batch tokens -> 48). CPU is slightly up but latency tails improving. proceeding to region.

deploy-bot: COMPLETE rollout: region-config/continuous-batching-toggle @ 1769999120.

anya: next: reduce max_batch_tokens on serving config: editing /etc/redwood/serving/batching.yaml and restarting worker for warm drain. patch snippet: ```yaml
max_batch_tokens: 64
max_wait_ms: 10
```

lucas: I'll apply to the pool and do rolling restart of 3 worker replicas per node. doing now.

jamal: while that's happening, we should free blockmanager pressure. manual eviction command: `rbctl evict --pool=kv_paged_pool --target-free-percent=60 --grace=30s` — run on control plane.

anyа: (typo) I mean Anya: I'll run eviction. running: `rbctl evict --pool=kv_paged_pool --target-free-percent=60`

anya: eviction kicked off 08:20 UTC. logs: `evict: reclaimed 14 blocks on node-07, 10 on node-09, 18 on node-11`. memory reclaimed ~28GB total.

michael: after eviction, blockmanager entries stabilized. metadata regen cycles dropped dramatically. disk IO down to baseline.

karen: patch plan for block manager: smaller block_size reduces worst-case regen latency but increases metadata overhead. quick patch: `block_size_mb: 32 -> 16` for paged pool, with fallback to previous if metadata overhead regresses. I can PR hotfix and hand the deploy to infra.

lucas: started canary deploy of block-manager-hotfix v2.1.9 (block_size change) on 2 nodes. deploy-bot: STARTED.

deploy-bot: COMPLETE rollout: block-manager-hotfix v2.1.9 @ 1769999430.

michael: metrics post-hotfix: blockmanager regen latency p99 down 60%, p95 token latency back to within acceptable SLO for most tenants. a couple of tenants still show transient 5xx — following up.

anya: customer-impact note: acme-inc saw ~12% request failures during 08:13-08:30; quickchat had increased p95 600ms -> 2.1s for same window. No data corruption. we'll prepare a short incident summary for product and cs.

jamal: created INC-2026-1377 (internal) with timeline and actions, assigned to eng-runtime for postmortem.

karen: follow-ups: - automated canary checks for metadata regen after deploys - add alert for sustained blockmanager regen loops (>3 loops in 5m) - evaluate default block_size per workload - add a guarded rollback to reduce block_size change blast-radius.

anya: handoff: I'm available for the next 30m, then passing to jamal for overnight monitoring. jamal you're up for owner?

jamal: taking handoff. will keep watch on dashboards and escalate if anything reappears. next update in 2 hours or on change.

michael: thanks team. I'll follow up with a small PR to add a temporary limit on continuous-batching rollout to catch similar regressions earlier.

incident-bot: NOTE: Handoff recorded. Oncall owner: jamal. Severity downgraded to SEV2 at 1769999600 after fix verification.

karen: scheduled postmortem kickoff meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC. I'll create the Confluence doc and include the config diffs and customer impact notes. :white_check_mark:
